catalyst_rows.indication: celiac disease (AVALON Phase 1 MAD with gluten challenge)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Data from the multiple ascending dose portion of the Phase 1 AVALON clinical trial, which includes a gluten challenge following three doses of test medication, is expected in the second half of 2026.

Barinthus Bio expects to complete the merger with Clywedog mid-2026. Upon the closing of the transaction, the combined company will be renamed 'Clywedog Therapeutics Holdings, Inc.' and is expected to trade on the NASDAQ under the new ticker symbol 'CLYD.'

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 adds 2H 2026 VTP-1000 MAD readout and mid-2026 reverse-merger close (ticker change to CLYD).
